title: 第15章 那应该是天生的了第16章 让你久等了
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“谢谢你，梦兮。”忆无情舒缓了一口气，感激道。
他依旧没有睁开双眼，他能感觉到，这灭生圣瞳必然不简单。
现在应该也快融合完毕了。
“你没事就好。”柳梦兮脸上浮现出一丝笑意。
不多时，忆无情缓缓睁开双眼，此时他的眼中神光流转，白光环绕，魅力十足，令柳梦兮看得有些痴了。
忆无情眼中光芒散去，看向发愣的柳梦兮，笑道：“感觉到我眼睛有什么变化吗？”
柳梦兮回过神来，呢喃道：“变得……比更好看了。”
忆无情：“……”
“我是问你有什么特别之处吗？”忆无情没好气道。
“唔……”柳梦兮思索了一会，道：“就是比之前好看了，这不是特别之处吗？”
“好吧。”忆无情不再坚持，他尝试了一下运转灭生圣瞳，双眼发出璀璨白光，看向柳梦兮。
“嘶~非礼勿视，非礼勿视。”忆无情连忙移开双眼，没想到这还有透视功能，真是逆天。
别的道统他不知道，但寒月宫他知道，寒月宫的衣服都是特殊材质制成的，能防止任何窥视，也能挡住一些攻击。
毕竟寒月宫都是女修，肯定是需要一些保障的。
自己这双眼睛的这项功能真是……太逆天了。
不仅如此，应该还有许多功能没被自己挖掘的，不过也快了。
“怎么了？”柳梦兮有些疑惑忆无情为何转过头去。
“你今年多大了？”忆无情问道。
“今年19岁了哦。”柳梦兮老实答道。
“额……19岁，那应该是天生的了。”忆无情暗暗道。

“啊？什么天生的？”柳梦兮脑袋凑到忆无情眼前，一脸好奇。
“没什么。”忆无情正色道。
开玩笑，自己可是正人君子。
但又话说回来，19岁的破凡境，现在仙界天骄都这么逆天了吗？
“无情，我们该怎么走呢？难道真要加入仙庭吗？”柳梦兮小脸垮下去，很是苦恼。
“别怕，我不会加入仙庭的，我们也不会被困在这里的。”忆无情摸了摸柳梦兮的小脑袋，语气温柔。
“嗯……”柳梦兮眯起双眼，表情轻松起来。
她感觉这样很舒服。
忆无情看向外界，双眼微微放光。
他看到外界的场景了，但没有看到天婷雪，下方众人也不见踪影。
“看来是帝战了，只是不知道是谁在与天婷雪战斗。”忆无情喃喃道。
content_en:
"Thank you, Mengxi." Yi Qingwu breathed a sigh of relief and said gratefully.
He still didn't open his eyes, but he could feel that the Life-Destroying Holy Eye was certainly not simple.
The integration should be almost complete now.
"It's good that you're okay." A smile appeared on Liu Mengxi's face.
Not long after, Yi Qingqing slowly opened his eyes. At this time, his eyes were filled with divine light, surrounded by white light, full of charm, which made Liu Mengxi look a little crazy.
The light in Yi Qingqing's eyes dissipated, he looked at Liu Mengxi who was in a daze, and said with a smile: "Do you feel any changes in my eyes?"
Liu Mengxi came back to her senses and murmured: "Becoming...better-looking than ever."
Yi Qingqing: "..."
"I'm asking you, is there anything special about you?" Yi Qingqing said angrily.
"Well..." Liu Mengxi thought for a while and said, "It just looks better than before. Isn't that something special?"
"Okay." Yi Qingqing no longer insisted. He tried to activate the Life-Destroying Holy Eyes, his eyes glowed with bright white light, and he looked at Liu Mengxi.
"Hiss~ Don't look at anything that's inappropriate, don't look at anything that's inappropriate." Yi Qingqing quickly moved her eyes away, but she didn't expect that it also had a see-through function, which was really unbelievable.
He didn't know about other Taoist traditions, but he knew about Hanyue Palace. The clothes in Hanyue Palace were made of special materials, which could prevent any prying eyes and block some attacks.
After all, Hanyue Palace is full of female cultivators, so they definitely need some protection.
This function of my own eyes is really...unbelievable.
Not only that, there should be many functions that have not been explored by myself, but it will be soon.
"What's wrong?" Liu Mengxi was a little confused as to why Yi Qingqing turned her head.
"How old are you this year?" Yi Qingqing asked.
"I am 19 years old this year." Liu Mengxi answered honestly.
"Um...19 years old, that should be natural." Yi Qingqing said secretly.
"Ah? What's natural?" Liu Mengxi put her head in front of Yi Qingqing with a curious look on her face.
"Nothing." Yi Qingqing said seriously.
Just kidding, I am a gentleman.
But then again, at the age of 19, are all the geniuses in the immortal world so defiant now that they are in the Mortal Realm?
"Qingwu, how should we go? Do we really want to join the Immortal Court?" Liu Mengxi's face fell, and she was very distressed.
"Don't be afraid, I won't join the Immortal Court, and we won't be trapped here." Yi Wuqing touched Liu Mengxi's little head with a gentle tone.
"Hmm..." Liu Mengxi narrowed her eyes, her expression relaxed.
She felt very comfortable this way.
Yi Qingqing looked towards the outside world, his eyes shining slightly.
He saw the scene outside, but he didn't see Tian Tingxue, and the people below were nowhere to be seen.
"It seems that the emperor is fighting, but I don't know who is fighting Tian Tingxue." Yi Qingqing murmured.
